overclaim_sweep.adversary_recommendation: Downgrade scope to REPRESENTATIVE (keep STRONG): the unity is the artifact of a single frozen lexeme within a single narrative cycle, not evidence of productive root-level semantics; UNIVERSAL would overclaim beyond the sampled distribution.
overclaim_sweep.rationale: The nucleus 'rigid hand-held rod' genuinely explains all 12 occurrences with no smuggled context, so the bounded lexicalized claim is STRONG. But because it is one lexeme with zero derivational spread and every attestation lies inside the Moses/magicians narrative, the evidence does not support a UNIVERSAL root generalization. The adversary's cap to REPRESENTATIVE is evidence-supported and adopted; strength is preserved because the bounded claim is 12/12 unambiguous.

research_questions.q1_contribution: The root contributes a single concrete count noun: عَصَا / عِصِيّ = a rigid, elongated, hand-held rod/staff. It supplies only the physical-object concept, nothing abstract or verbal.
research_questions.q2_one_or_multiple: One nucleus. All 12 occurrences are the same lexeme; singular vs. broken plural and possessive person are inflectional, not sense-splitting.
research_questions.q3_challenging: The plural magicians' staffs at 20:66:6:2 and 26:44:3:2 (coordinated with حِبَال 'ropes') test whether the lexeme is Moses-specific or inherently miraculous — it is neither; and 20:18:3:1 gives purely mundane uses (leaning, beating foliage), blocking any attempt to read miracle/weapon into the root.
research_questions.q4_lexicalized: Yes — fully lexicalized. Only one frozen noun paradigm surfaces (عَصَا / عِصِيّ), with no productive semantic field in the packet.
research_questions.q5_family_narrower: No derivational family is attested; the whole sampled root reduces to this single noun paradigm, so root generalization and lexicalized class coincide in-sample and cannot be distinguished here.
research_questions.q6_tempting_feature: The transformation-into-serpent (26:32, 26:45, 7:107, 27:10, 28:31, 7:117) and sea/rock-splitting (26:63, 2:60, 7:160) tempt loading miracle/power onto the root, but these are carried by the governing verbs (أَلْقِ, اضْرِب) and narrative, external to the noun.
research_questions.q7_falsifier: A non-nominal ESw form (verb/verbal noun/participle) or any ESw occurrence with a non-staff, abstract/relational denotation would fracture the single-lexeme nucleus. None exists in the packet.
research_questions.q8_reopen: Reopen if a derivationally distinct ESw form appears (to test a root-level abstract core), or if any ESw occurrence is found outside the Moses/magicians narrative cycle.

overclaim_sweep.adversary_recommendation: Downgrade to WEAK / REPRESENTATIVE / LEXICALIZED_CLASS / UNRESOLVED, on the grounds that ~110 of 133 tokens are the bleached substantive ٱلدُّنْيَا whose 'world' meaning is context-fed (ٱلْـَٔاخِرَة antithesis), the non-dunyaa elatives fracture across distance/quantity/value/construction antonyms, and 2:61 may be a homophonous baseness root.
overclaim_sweep.rationale: Both analysts' STRONG/UNIVERSAL fails the overclaim gate: the nucleus does NOT explain EVERY occurrence at the clause level without smuggled context — in the ~110-token ٱلدُّنْيَا mass the operative 'this world' meaning is supplied by lexicalization + the ٱلْـَٔاخِرَة antithesis, and the modal 'more likely' set is supplied by the أَدْنَىٰ+أَن construction. So UNIVERSAL/STRONG is not defensible. BUT the adversary's UNRESOLVED/WEAK overcorrects: the occurrences DO discriminate — the concrete anchors (53:8 دنا 'drew near'; 8:42 dunyaa explicitly vs quSwaa 'farther'; 55:54/69:23/76:14/6:99 low-hanging/reachable fruit and shade) admit no competing nucleus, and a baseness-only or lexicalized-only account cannot generate them. The nucleus 'nearness/lowness' is therefore genuinely PREFERRED, not unresolved, and its cross-form convergence makes it a ROOT_GENERALIZATION. The calibrated middle — MODERATE strength, REPRESENTATIVE scope (sampling_basis documenting the productive base vs the bleached mass) — keeps what the packet proves (a single well-anchored nucleus that is the root's contribution throughout) while refusing what it does not (that nearness is the live meaning of the dominant lexicalized tokens, or that the construction-supplied modal and predicate-supplied 'worldly' senses belong to the root).

research_questions.q1_contribution: The root د ن و contributes NEARNESS / PROXIMITY: 'near, close, low, within reach' (verb دَنَا 53:8; form-IV يُدْنِينَ 33:59:8; participle دَانٍ/دَانِيَة 55:54, 69:23, 76:14, 6:99), whose elative أدنى grades onto scales as 'nearer/lower/lesser/fewer' (8:42, 30:3, 53:9, 32:21, 58:7, 73:20). That grading is the root's whole semantic share; nothing evaluative or theological is added by the root itself.
research_questions.q2_one_or_multiple: ONE nucleus. All packet forms reduce to 'near/low', and the classes are bridged inside the packet (7:169 الأدنى parallel to الدنيا; 8:42 dunyaa used spatially vs quSwaa; السماء الدنيا = nearest heaven), so there is no second unbridged lexical nucleus — only one lexicalized offshoot (ٱلدُّنْيَا='this world') within the same etymon.
research_questions.q3_challenging: Hardest tokens: (a) 2:61 أدنى opposed to خير = 'inferior/meaner' — a value antonym, bridgeable only via 'low end of scale' and possibly a homophonous root d-n-' (unverifiable from packet); (b) the أَدْنَىٰ+أَن set (4:3, 2:282, 5:108, 33:51:17, 33:59:13) where 'more likely/apt' is the construction's, so the root's bare 'nearer-to-outcome' is barely visible; (c) the ~110 bleached ٱلْحَيَوٰة ٱلدُّنْيَا tokens (47:36, 57:20...) where nearness is synchronically inert.
research_questions.q4_lexicalized: Yes. ٱلدُّنْيَا / ٱلْحَيَوٰة ٱلدُّنْيَا = 'the present world/life' is a lexicalized feminine elative: its 'world' meaning is fixed by the ٱلْحَيَوٰة collocation and the ٱلْـَٔاخِرَة antithesis, not minted afresh from 'near' each token. This is the single dominant offshoot (~110/133).
research_questions.q5_family_narrower: Both levels are real. The ROOT_GENERALIZATION is warranted for the etymon (the same 'near/low' nucleus is shared by verb, participle, and elative — not an artifact of one form). But for practical glossing the honest units split: (a) the productive NEARNESS family (verb/participle/spatial+scalar elative) and (b) the LEXICALIZED CLASS ٱلدُّنْيَا='this world'. So the root generalization is affirmed, while a narrower lexicalized-class finding for ٱلدُّنْيَا is recommended alongside it.
research_questions.q6_tempting_feature: The tempting overclaim is to load the context onto the root: to let the dominant ٱلدُّنْيَا mass make 'this world / worldly / transient / deceptive' feel like the root's meaning, and thereby assert STRONG/UNIVERSAL. Those flavors come from lexicalization + the ٱلْـَٔاخِرَة antithesis + predicates (لعب/لهو/غرور), not from د ن و. Equally tempting is crediting the أَدْنَىٰ+أَن 'more likely' to the root rather than the construction.
research_questions.q7_falsifier: A concrete falsifier: any concrete/spatial anchor whose frame is incompatible with 'near/low' — e.g., if 8:42's ٱلْعُدْوَة ٱلدُّنْيَا were opposed to something other than ٱلْقُصْوَىٰ, if دَانِيَة fruit/shade were high/distant not low/reachable, or if in-packet morphology showed دَنَا and أَدْنَىٰ to be different roots. Checked against 53:8, 8:42, 55:54, 69:23, 76:14, 6:99, 30:3, 37:6/41:12/67:5, 53:9 — all converge on near/low, so the nucleus PASSES falsification.
research_questions.q8_reopen: Reopen if: orthographic/morphological evidence splits the value-sense أدنى (2:61) to a baseness root d-n-'; if a morphological tag separates lexicalized ٱلدُّنْيَا from the transparent elative; if any occurrence is found whose frame actively contradicts 'near/low'; or if governance elects to formalize a separate LEXICALIZED_CLASS finding for ٱلدُّنْيَا alongside this root generalization.

overclaim_sweep.adversary_recommendation: Downgrade to MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE / LEXICALIZED_CLASS: (1) morphological monoculture — all 40 are Form IV, so no contrast isolates a root-level meaning distinct from the Form IV stem; (2) thin the gloss — abstract 'success' is never grounded in a concrete internal anchor and the moral/eschatological content is frame-supplied.
overclaim_sweep.rationale: Adversary downgrade (1) is evidence-supported and accepted: with zero morphological contrast, a ROOT/UNIVERSAL claim overreaches; scope pinned to the attested Form IV derivational family. Strength lowered STRONG→MODERATE because the sense, though uniform across all 40 with clean polarity and no internal counterexample, is single-form and purely abstract, limiting confidence about the root's own contribution. Adversary's LEXICALIZED_CLASS was NOT fully adopted: the verb remains productive and transparent across positive (قَدْ أَفْلَحَ), negative (لَا يُفْلِحُ), and purposive (لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ) frames with widely varying subjects, so DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY better fits than a single frozen lexeme, though ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ is near-formulaic. State kept PREFERRED because the thin, properly-scoped nucleus has no internal counterexample.

research_questions.q1_contribution: The root's demonstrated contribution (only via Form IV) is a valence-neutral 'attain the desired favorable outcome — succeed, prosper, thrive, come out ahead,' asserted/denied/hoped-for of a class of persons (e.g., 23:1, 20:64, 10:17, 7:8).
research_questions.q2_one_or_multiple: One coherent nucleus. All 40 fit as affirmation, denial, purposive hope, or agent-designation of the same attainment; the polar affirm/deny distribution reinforces unity rather than fracturing it. No second lexical class is internally evidenced.
research_questions.q3_challenging: The worldly/competitive uses (20:64 مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ, 20:69 the sorcerer's craft, 18:20 escaping coercion) challenge any salvation reading — they do not break the thin nucleus but strip the root of intrinsic eschatological/moral content, forcing that content onto frame and complement.
research_questions.q4_lexicalized: Partially: ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ is a recurrent near-formulaic epithet (أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ) and قَدْ أَفْلَحَ / لَا يُفْلِحُ are fixed collocations, but meaning stays compositional from the productive verb, so I mark the family DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY, not a semantically drifted lexeme.
research_questions.q5_family_narrower: Yes — decisively. All 40 are Form IV with no Form I or concrete sense, so the demonstrated contribution is bound to the Form IV (أَفْلَحَ/مُفْلِح) family and is narrower than any root-level generalization; this drives REPRESENTATIVE scope.
research_questions.q6_tempting_feature: The dense pious co-text (believers, muttaqūn, self-purifiers, heavy scales, gardens) tempts loading 'salvation/felicity' onto the root; resisted because 20:64/20:69/18:20 use the same verb for worldly winning and the religious content lives in complements (تَزَكَّىٰ 87:14, زَكَّىٰهَا 91:9).
research_questions.q7_falsifier: A non-Form-IV/Form-I ف ل ح occurrence carrying the concrete agrarian sense (till/cleave/split soil), or any token that cannot be read as 'come out well' — such a case would prove multiple unbridged lexical classes and force LOCAL/UNRESOLVED at root level. None present in this packet.
research_questions.q8_reopen: Reopen if morphological contrast (Form I or other derivation) becomes available, if a concrete/agrarian sense surfaces, or if a Form-IV token resists the 'attain favorable outcome' gloss — any of which could break the nucleus or, conversely, license upgrading toward ROOT_GENERALIZATION.

overclaim_sweep.adversary_recommendation: Downgrade scope to REPRESENTATIVE on the grounds that a morphologically flat corpus (13x the same noun, no derivational spread) cannot evidence universal root behavior.
overclaim_sweep.rationale: The overclaim gate keeps STRONG/UNIVERSAL only if the nucleus explains EVERY occurrence with no smuggled context — which holds here. The bare 'mouth' reading substitutes in all 13/13 tokens, and three pure-physical anchors (13:14:18:1 water, 14:9:24:1 hands, 36:65:4:1 sealing) carry zero speech content, decisively preventing any abstraction from being smuggled in. The adversary's concern is a meta-argument about generalizing to productive ROOT behavior, but claim_scope_kind is already constrained to LEXICALIZED_CLASS, which explicitly acknowledges the single frozen lexeme. UNIVERSAL here means 'holds across all attested members of that lexicalized class' (13/13), a claim fully and cleanly supported. Because the flatness is honestly captured by LEXICALIZED_CLASS rather than ROOT_GENERALIZATION, no further scope downgrade is evidence-warranted; downgrading to REPRESENTATIVE would understate a nucleus that literally explains every occurrence.

research_questions.q1_contribution: The root contributes exactly one concept: 'mouth', the physical oral aperture of the body — an anatomical noun. Nothing more (no inherent 'speech', 'insincerity', or 'expression').
research_questions.q2_one_or_multiple: One single nucleus. All 13 tokens are the same concrete noun; the ingress/egress/instrument roles are frame effects (bi-/min-/verb) over one identical organ, not distinct lexical classes.
research_questions.q3_challenging: The purely physical uses 13:14:18:1 (water reaching mouth), 14:9:24:1 (hands into mouths), and 36:65:4:1 (mouths sealed to PREVENT speech) are the sharpest anchors: they defeat any speech-enriched nucleus. The بأفواههم cluster (9:8, 5:41, 3:167, 61:8) most challenges the thin reading by tempting an insincerity/futility overload — resolved as construction/context.
research_questions.q4_lexicalized: Yes. The root surfaces only as one frozen noun lexeme (فاه sg. / أفواه pl.), POS=N in all 13; no productive derivational activity is attested.
research_questions.q5_family_narrower: No. The single attested noun family coincides with the entire attested root; there is no narrower sub-family to distinguish, so derivational_family_narrower=false.
research_questions.q6_tempting_feature: The insincerity/lip-service and futile-opposition semantics of the بأفواههم...قلوبهم/نور pattern strongly tempt loading 'empty/false speech' onto the root; this is contributed by the bi-preposition, the verb of saying, and the explicit heart/light contrast, and must be kept off the root.
research_questions.q7_falsifier: A ف و ه occurrence where literal 'mouth' cannot be substituted, or a derived (non-noun) form meaning 'to utter/spread' independent of the organ, would break the thin nucleus. None exists in this packet.
research_questions.q8_reopen: Reopen if an extended corpus yields a non-substitutable occurrence, a derived abstract-sense form, or evidence that فاه/أفواه number alternation encodes a semantic split.

overclaim_sweep.adversary_recommendation: Downgrade to MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE with scope_kind LEXICALIZED_CLASS: the entire population is one lexicalized noun (no verb or other derivation attested), so no root-level derivational-family generalization is licensed; and everything beyond the thin 'young male human' content is context/construction, with the age feature ranging from unborn (3:40, 19:8) to agentive near-adult (18:80).
overclaim_sweep.rationale: Scope is downgraded from UNIVERSAL to REPRESENTATIVE (LEXICALIZED_CLASS) because all 13 tokens are a single noun lexeme with no derivational family attested, so a whole-root claim would overstate. Strength is downgraded from STRONG to MODERATE, honoring the evidence-supported part of the adversary's downgrade: while the minimal nucleus does survive 13/13 with no smuggled context, the root pins down very little — [+male] and a loose [+young] whose age band is context-modulated (unborn → near-adult) — and every characterful reading (son, servant, commodity, age) is frame-borne. The result is a robust but thin lexeme-level generalization, best rendered MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE rather than a strong universal root claim.

research_questions.q1_contribution: The root contributes, in every occurrence, the noun ghulām = a young male human (boy/youth), with two invariant features [+male] and [+young/pre-full-adult] and nothing more; roles like promised son, foundling, slain innocent, orphan heir, and Paradise server are frame-borne.
research_questions.q2_one_or_multiple: One coherent nucleus. The apparent split between an 'offspring' cluster (annunciation tokens) and a non-relational cluster (12:19, 18:74, 18:80, 18:82, 52:24) is bridgeable because both share [+male][+young] and the offspring relation is carried by the possessive/gift construction, not the noun; there is no unbridged second lexical class.
research_questions.q3_challenging: 52:24 (ghilmān as servers — service is in يَطُوفُ, not the noun; لَّهُمْ = belonging-to not born-to), 3:40 and 19:8 (an unborn/promised son, so no present 'youth'), 18:80 (a near-adult with moral agency), 12:19 (Joseph as saleable بِضَٰعَة), and 19:19 (the strongest 'son' pressure, resolved by لِأَهَبَ لَكِ).
research_questions.q4_lexicalized: Yes. Every token is a single concrete noun (ghulām / ghulāmayn / ghilmān), POS=N; the meaning is lexicalized in this noun.
research_questions.q5_family_narrower: Yes. No verbal or adjectival derivation of غ ل م is attested — only number inflection of one noun — so the attested derivational family is strictly narrower than a productive root; hence LEXICALIZED_CLASS, not ROOT_GENERALIZATION.
research_questions.q6_tempting_feature: The temptation is to load 'son/offspring' onto the root from the eight annunciation/'how can I have a ghulām' tokens (and secondarily 'servant' from 52:24). Both are resisted: filiation is marked by لِى/لَكِ/بِـ + بَشَّرَ, and 52:24/12:19/18:74 carry ghulām with no filiation at all.
research_questions.q7_falsifier: The minimal nucleus 'young male human' would be falsified by any ghulām token denoting a female, a full-grown/old male, or a non-human, or by a bare (frame-unmarked) token still forcing 'son'/'servant.' No such token exists in the packet, so the falsifier passes; conversely every richer nucleus (son / servant / fixed-age) is already falsified within the packet (52:24, 12:19 break 'son'; singular tokens break 'servant'; 3:40/19:8 vs 18:80 break any fixed age).
research_questions.q8_reopen: Reopen if a derived verb or other lexeme of غ ل م with unrelated meaning is attested elsewhere, or if any occurrence shows a female / adult / non-human ghulām, or shows [+male] or [+young] cancelled without contradiction.
